name: UA2 detector
notes: Detector site placement carries the same LSS4-vs-LSS5 caveat as site:cern-sps-lss4-ua2 (see that record's notes): the specific SPS hall was not independently verified by a fetched source this session.

technology_class 'spectrometer' is used rather than 'general_purpose_collider' because UA2 explicitly had no muon detector and relied on calorimetry rather than a magnetic central tracker for its core physics case (home.cern: 'There was no muon detector').

calorimeters.quote: The apparatus has complete calorimetry, both electromagnetic and hadronic, down to about 5 degrees to the beams.
calorimeters.value: Complete electromagnetic and hadronic calorimetry down to about 5 degrees from the beam

muon_system.value: None: UA2 had no muon detector

tracker.quote: A total of 6096 independent silicon counters give a precise dE/dx measurement.
tracker.value: 6,096 independent silicon dE/dx counters; scintillating-fibre tracker (SFD) added in the 1985-1987 upgrade, followed by a silicon pad detector

description.quote: The apparatus has complete calorimetry, both electromagnetic and hadronic, down to about 5 degrees to the beams.
description.value: Complete calorimetric coverage down to about 5 degrees from the beam line, used for electron and jet identification and energy measurement.

description.locator: University of Cambridge HEP, UA2 page
description.quote: a new scintillating fibre detector (SFD) that improved the UA2 tracking and electron identification performance.
description.value: A scintillating-fibre tracker added in the 1985-1987 upgrade to improve tracking and electron identification.

summary.plain: A detector built almost entirely from calorimeters, layered like an onion around the beam pipe, that measured energy rather than bending particle tracks in a magnet.
summary.technical: Non-magnetic, highly segmented calorimetric spectrometer: complete electromagnetic and hadronic calorimetry down to about 5 degrees from the beam, 6,096 independent silicon dE/dx counters, no muon detector; upgraded in 1985-1987 with a scintillating-fibre tracker (and later a silicon pad detector) to improve tracking and electron identification.

technology.quote: UA2 had electromagnetic and hadronic calorimeters to detect electrons and hadrons. ... There was no muon detector.
technology.value: Non-magnetic, highly segmented electromagnetic and hadronic calorimeter with a scintillating-fibre tracker added in 1985-1987
